title: Repositories/services constructed inline instead of injected via a provider at three sync-path call sites
why: SM-7 requires repositories/services/DAOs to be constructed only inside their @riverpod provider or a test override, so they stay swappable in tests without also having to fake the DB the constructor pulls in. All three sites construct a repository/service directly inside a plain method body, given only the already-available UserDatabase. A unit test of pushAllLocalData, buildGamificationSnapshot, or the reward-merge delegate cannot substitute a fake ParentAnalyticsRepositoryImpl/RewardMilestoneService without also faking the whole Drift database those classes read. This is a repo-wide pattern (23 similar sites exist outside this batch too, e.g. lib/core/navigation/guards/restore_guard.dart), not unique to these three, so the cost here is real but modest.
recommendation: Where these services need independent test substitution, accept them as constructor parameters (defaulting to the real implementation) instead of instantiating inline; lower priority given the pattern is pervasive repo-wide and each site is already exercisable via a real in-memory DB, as this batch's own tests demonstrate.
acceptance_criteria: SM-7 Rule-0 checker (audit grep for direct Repository/Service/Dao construction outside provider/test files) either passes for these three sites or the finding is explicitly filed as backlog alongside the wider repo-wide pattern.
